lines.1: 「So there you have it. I show no mercy to women or children.」
lines.2: 「Everything you just said is despicable, but right now, that makes you incredibly reliable!」
lines.3: 「All right, let's go. Just imagining that prickly girl crying and apologizing to me puts a smile on my face.」
lines.4: 「I'll overcome the trauma my sister inflicted right here. Women should be weak! Women should devote themselves to men!」
lines.5: 「They left. Do you think they'll be okay?」
lines.7: 「Crabby looked strangely out for blood. Who did she go off to kill?」
lines.11: 「Otome is simply too much for them to handle.」
lines.13: 「The student council president and the head of the disciplinary committee are bound to know each other.」
lines.14: 「I see. Crab got warned by her, and now she's holding a grudge.」
lines.15: 「Crabby and Otome, huh? They sound like a terrible match.」
lines.16: 「Otome really comes down hard on people.」
lines.18: 「I'm the secretary of the student council executive committee.」
lines.20: The student council had nothing whatsoever to do with my everyday school life.
lines.21: I barely knew who held which position.
